name: 9 Luger
evidence: Primary designation is the 9x19mm Parabellum, a handgun cartridge. SAAMI lists 9mm Luger as a centerfire pistol cartridge, and the repository's own data/schema/003_seed_reference_data.sql line 18 seeds slug '9mm-luger' with family 'pistol' for the same cartridge. Also filed separately as 9-mm-luger-p (family=pistol) and 30-luger (family=pistol).
ambiguity: None. Every independent signal in this repository points to pistol.
proposed_action: CHANGE family to pistol AND de-duplicate: a second row, slug 9mm-luger (id 1, family pistol), already represents this cartridge with identical saami_max_psi=35000. Changing family alone leaves two rows for one cartridge.

name: .22 LR
evidence: Rimfire. The .22 Long Rifle is genuinely chambered in both rifle and handgun, and both uses are legitimate. The repository already holds sibling rows .22RF Short and .22RF Long & LR (both family=rifle) plus 22-jet and 22-short, so the naming does not settle it either.
ambiguity: GENUINELY AMBIGUOUS. Unlike 9 Luger, .22 LR has no single correct family. Filing it under rifle is defensible and matches the sibling .22RF rows. This row is reported as ambiguous, NOT as a defect to fix.
proposed_action: LEAVE ALONE. Do not change. Resolving it needs a policy decision (one row per cartridge-platform vs one row per cartridge), not a data correction.

name: 4 Bore Rifle

The defect is in the NAME, which says 'Rifle' and contradicts both the family and the cartridge.

name: .327 Fed
evidence: Federal .327 Truncated is a handgun rimfire cartridge (0.327 in / 8.5 mm), introduced for semi-automatic pistols. SAAMI lists it among pistol cartridges. It sits in rifle.csv with family=rifle.
ambiguity: Partial. The bare designation '.327 Fed' is less self-evidently a handgun cartridge than '9 Luger' - there is no Federal .327 rifle. Confidence is medium, not high, and this row was NOT in the source KNOWLEDGE.md, which named only two cases.
proposed_action: ESCALATE, do not silently change. Confirm against SAAMI Z299.3 before applying. Listed here because the brief asked for every case, not only the known two.
